item.title: Daily Minute — September 10, 2026
item.description:
It is this; there is Someone with you Whose judgement is perfect. He does know all the facts, past, present, and to come. He does know all the effects of His judgement on everyone and everything involved in any way. And He is wholly fair to everyone, for there is no distortion in His perception.

item.title: Lesson 89: These are our review ideas for today:
item.description: These are our review ideas for today: [77] “I am entitled to miracles.” I am entitled to miracles because I am under no laws but God’s. His laws release me from all grievances, and replace them with miracles. And I would accept the miracles in place of the grievances, which are but illusions that hide the miracles beyond.
